en.app.description: Splits a share-bike ride into segments short enough to stay inside the free window, and says where to dock.
en.app.name: Redock
en.app.title: Redock, a share-bike trip planner for Montreal
en.attribution.label: Attributions
en.corrections.byKey.bikeReserve: Bike and dock reserves are whole positive numbers.
en.corrections.byKey.cyclingSpeed: Cycling speed must be greater than zero.
en.corrections.byKey.detourFactor: The detour factor cannot go below 1: a street is never shorter than a straight line.
en.corrections.byKey.dockCooldown: The wait after docking cannot be negative.
en.corrections.byKey.dockReserve: Bike and dock reserves are whole positive numbers.
en.corrections.byKey.freeWindow: The free window must be a real, positive duration.
en.corrections.byKey.maxWalkDistance: The maximum walk cannot be negative.
en.corrections.byKey.overageRate: The rate past the window cannot be negative.
en.corrections.byKey.safetyMargin: The safety margin must be positive and shorter than the free window.
en.corrections.byKey.segmentOverhead: Unlocking and docking must take less than a segment's budget.
en.corrections.byKey.walkingSpeed: Walking speed must be greater than zero.
en.corrections.fallback: These settings cannot produce a trip. Adjust them and try again.
en.empty.call: Set a start and a destination: the ride is split into segments that stay free, and every stop is named.
en.empty.label: How this works
en.empty.lead(\"30 min\"): Your subscription includes 30 min per ride. Docking the bike at a station resets that counter.
en.empty.title: Stay inside the free window

en.feed.stale(7): This data is 7 min old and may no longer match the stations.

en.feed.unavailable.malformed.title: The station data cannot be read
en.feed.unavailable.network.detail: The network did not answer. Check your connection, then retry.
en.feed.unavailable.network.title: The station data is unreachable

en.feed.unavailable.out-of-season.title: The network is out of season
en.fields.searchUnavailable: Address search is not responding. Tap the map to place the point, or type coordinates such as “45.5088, -73.5878”.
en.fields.swap: Swap the start and the destination
en.fields.swapUnavailable: Swap the start and the destination, available once one of them is set
en.gauge.spoken(10, \"comfortable\"): about 10 min of free window left on arrival, comfortable
en.gauge.spoken(10, \"confortable\"): about 10 min of free window left on arrival, confortable
en.language.label: Language
en.map.hintGeolocationDenied: Your location is unavailable. Type an address, or tap the map to place your start.
en.map.hintPicking(\"destination\"): Tap the map to place your destination, or type an address.
en.map.hintPicking(\"origin\"): Tap the map to place your start, or type an address.
en.map.hintPlaced: Drag a point to adjust it.

en.panel.label: Trip planner

en.plan.failures.no-station-near-origin: No station within walking distance of your start. Raise your walking distance, or move your start.
en.plan.failures.origin-out-of-coverage: Your start is outside the area this network serves. Move it into a sector covered by the stations shown on the map.

en.settings.controls.overageRate.label: Rate past the window
